end.summary:
Defined food miles as the total distance from farm through markets to shop.
Added distances correctly: 30 km + 12 km = 42 km.
Compared longer and shorter journeys, linking distance with fuel use, smoke, pollution and freshness.
Suggested local, seasonal foods and nearby sources; revised the plan to allow non-local fruit when local seasonal fruit is unavailable.
Did not complete the final teach-back on ways to reduce food miles and their limits.
end.parentNote: Asha practised food miles, adding journey distances, and comparing fuel use, pollution, freshness and cost. Rohan explained the ideas using examples such as apples from Himachal to Chennai and seasonal mangoes; they also corrected the plan of choosing only nearby fruit to “when available, choose nearby seasonal fruit.” At home, ask them to choose two foods and trace their likely journey, then suggest one practical local or seasonal alternative.

अरे हाँ, अगर सिर्फ पास का लेंगे तो सर्दी में फल ही नहीं मिलेगा। तो 'जब मिले, पास का सीजनल फल लो' वाला प्लान अच्छा है। उसमें स्कूल फल दे पाएगा।
Haan, aapne dekha ki sirf paas ka phal lene se sardiyon mein school ke paas phal na bhi ho sakta hai. Ab pichhli baat yaad karein: khaana bahut door se aaye toh kaunsi do samasyaayein ho sakti hain?
ek toh pradooshan zyada hoga. doosra, truck me itna time lagta hai ki khaana taaza nahi rahega.
Door ka safar pradooshan badha sakta hai. Khaana kam taaza bhi ho sakta hai, par hamesha aisa nahi hota. Ek aur baat sochiye: truck ko lamba safar karne ke liye kis cheez ki zyada zaroorat padti hai?
